title: Swift Optimized
description: Lightning-fast optimization for stable framerates and zero stutter. Delivers high 1% lows and maximum performance
body:
# Swift Optimized

Experience Minecraft at lightning speed. A high-performance, lightweight optimization modpack engineered for maximum stability, even on integrated graphics.

## 📊 Performance Benchmarks

We don't just chase peak FPS; we prioritize **frame stability (1% lows)**. As shown below, Swift Optimized significantly outperforms popular alternatives in extreme stress tests (TNT & Mobs), eliminating micro-stutters.

| Test Scenario | Swift Optimized (Ours) | Fabulously Optimized | Rapid Optimization |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Chests** (Block Entities) | **150 - 165 FPS** | 140 - 150 FPS | 140 - 170 FPS |
| **TNTs** (Particles/Physics) | **40 - 60 FPS** 🏆 | 25 - 60 FPS | 20 - 60 FPS |
| **Mobs** (Entity AI/Render) | **60 - 70 FPS** 🏆 | 50 - 60 FPS | 50 - 60 FPS |

*Note: The significantly higher minimum FPS in TNT and Mob tests means a much smoother, stutter-free experience during intense gameplay moments.*

## 💻 Test Environment
Proven to run exceptionally well on **Integrated Graphics (iGPU)**:
- **Target Version:** 26.1.2
- **CPU:** Intel Core i5-13500H
- **GPU:** Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics (iGPU)
- **RAM:** 32GB (5200 MT/s)

---

# Swift Optimized 中文介绍

以闪电般的速度体验 Minecraft。这是一款专为极致稳定性打造的高性能轻量级优化整合包，即使在核心显卡上也能流畅运行。

## 📊 性能基准测试

我们不只追求峰值帧数，更看重**帧率稳定性（1% Low 帧）**。如下表所示，在极端压力测试（TNT 和生物）中，Swift Optimized 显著优于主流替代方案，有效消除微卡顿。

| 测试场景 | Swift Optimized (本整合包) | Fabulously Optimized | Rapid Optimization |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **箱子** (方块实体) | **150 - 165 FPS** | 140 - 150 FPS | 140 - 170 FPS |
| **TNT** (粒子与物理) | **40 - 60 FPS** 🏆 | 25 - 60 FPS | 20 - 60 FPS |
| **生物** (AI与渲染) | **60 - 70 FPS** 🏆 | 50 - 60 FPS | 50 - 60 FPS |

*注：在 TNT 和生物测试中显著更高的最低帧（下限），意味着在激烈的游戏瞬间能获得更流畅、无卡顿的体验。*

## 💻 测试环境

经测试，在**核心显卡 (iGPU)** 上表现优异：
- **目标版本:** 26.1.2
- **处理器 (CPU):** Intel Core i5-13500H
- **显卡 (GPU):** Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics (核显)
- **内存 (RAM):** 32GB (5200 MT/s)
